en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a richly decorated fountain with a bronze statue of Neptune holding a trident, enclosed by an ornate wrought‑iron fence. The fountain stands in a cobblestone square lined with tall, narrow, gabled townhouses in Northern European Hanseatic style. On the right edge is a large brick building. People in early 20th‑century clothing and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. A shop sign with German text can be seen in the background.
